source: Codex re-probe c6 (tool-free turn) and cat (the first initialize took 38.1 s with a fresh CODEX_SQLITE_HOME; replayed behind the driver's gate), 0.159.2, 2026-09-30; model/list reply spliced from re-probe cat (3 of 8 rows, descriptions neutralized); thread/start sandbox echo and turn/start sandboxPolicy adapted from the recorded read-only bound to dangerFullAccess (full, the only bound VIA admits); c6's hook/started and hook/completed notifications dropped (c6 ran with hooks on; VIA launches with --disable hooks); the run ends at VIA's stdin close (await_eof) after its last close, as the probe closed stdin at the end of the run (exit 0 recorded)

params.prompt: Reply with exactly VIA_ENV_159. Do not use any tools.

expect.notes: The initialize reply is delayed (38.1 s live; here held until the gate): the handshake deadline is the turn's remaining wall time, never a shorter fixed bound (vendors/codex.md §2 Shared ownership; adapters design §2 cold start). The instance version is parsed from initialize.userAgent `via/0.159.2 (...)`: the token after the client name and `/` (C2 §5; vendors/codex.md §1). argv pins `--disable hooks` (vendors/codex.md §4). One keyless usage sample gives scope turn (C2 §5 AD6). The gate holds the initialize reply (replay step 2) while controlled time advances 40,000 ms, past the recorded 38.1 s handshake; the C1 default wall budget (3,600,000 ms) covers it, since the handshake deadline is the turn's remaining wall time (vendor spec §2). A fixed short handshake timeout fails the case.
